tool_args.rationale: The source notes match the observed base-field, sink-gradient, and monotone-concave signatures to a siphon base with an open square-root branch. Five varied pilot rows already identify its three parameters, so a further paid probe is unnecessary. The numerical fit uses the supplied broad fallback bounds to allow rho to move away from its warm start.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows span s_grad=0.35 to 2.34 and already identify the three-parameter siphon-base plus square-root branch under the authorized guidance.
No reduced slow-ODE temporal mechanism is indicated; signatures and source notes point to the static monotone-concave branch.
Its decline at high u_now conflicts with the observed increasing, saturating pilot response.
A multiplicative power law does not match the observed concave saturation as directly as the matched siphon subtree.
It is explicitly irrelevant to identifying the supported three-parameter mechanism.
